methodology.lead: Source priority, handling of unknowns, conflict resolution, exchange-rate and token-cost math, timestamp rules. The README is just the entry point; the method lives here.
methodology.source.official: Official (highest): pricing pages, product docs, API docs, terms of service, privacy policy, model docs, FAQ, announcements, official GitHub.
methodology.source.measured: Measured: PlanScope's own measurements (TTFT, TPS, decode TPS, latency, 429s, error rate, token usage, real quota behaviour), always recorded separately from vendor claims.
methodology.source.community: Community (supporting): GitHub Issues, Reddit, Discord, Telegram, forums, blogs, user reports — community reports are signals, not authoritative facts.
methodology.source.marketing: Vendor marketing copy is never treated as the sole factual basis.
methodology.unknown.unverified: Not verified → value: null or status: unknown. Nothing is ever invented.
methodology.unknown.vague: Vague vendor wording (Unlimited / High Usage / Fair Use / Reasonable Usage) is recorded verbatim with actual_limit_known: false.
methodology.unknown.validator: The validator rejects only broken structures and illegal formats — missing information never fails it.
methodology.conflict.priority: Official docs > official announcements > measurements > community.
methodology.conflict.keepBoth: Both sides of a conflict are kept with their own checked_at; the higher-priority source becomes the factual value and history is never silently overwritten.
methodology.conflict.unresolved: When it cannot be resolved, the field stays unknown and the conflict is recorded in the note.
methodology.exchange.avg: planscope fetch-rate averages the valid USD/CNY daily values over D-7 ~ D-1 (Asia/Shanghai, the last 7 complete calendar days):
methodology.exchange.validOnly: Only daily values the source actually published inside the window are used: no weekend backfill, no interpolation, no same-day value, no fallback, no retry; if today has no valid value the CI fails and waits for the next day.
methodology.exchange.writeFile: The result is written to config/exchange_rate.yaml, which holds only the single key usd_cny.
methodology.exchange.singleSource: That file is the single USD → CNY source for the whole project: nothing is hardcoded, defined twice, or fetched from the network at runtime.
methodology.exchange.approx: It is an approximation for cross-plan comparison, not a live payment, financial settlement, bank or card rate.
methodology.cny.condition: (only when the original currency is USD; CNY is used as-is; other currencies are never force-converted)
methodology.cny.keepOriginal: Original price and currency are always kept; CNY is derived and exists only in the presentation layer.
methodology.cny.promotion: Promotional prices are recorded separately and never overwrite the standard price.
methodology.token.storeFacts: Source facts are stored first: original price, currency, token quota, model multipliers.
methodology.token.compute: Then compute: Effective RMB / 1M input tokens, / 1M output tokens, / 1M weighted tokens.
methodology.token.unclear: When quota or multipliers are unclear, mark not directly comparable instead of force-estimating.
methodology.token.noScore: No subjective “best” score is ever emitted; every sort is on an objective field.
methodology.community.record: Written to data/providers/<provider>/community/, and must carry source_type and confidence (high / medium / low).
methodology.community.notFacts: They never enter the factual fields of privacy / plan / model records.
methodology.benchmark.note: — every record is labelled individually and never blended into a single number.
methodology.history.iso: ISO 8601 throughout: 2026-09-23T10:30:00+08:00. Every dynamic record carries at least checked_at.
methodology.history.effective: Changes are expressed with effective_from / effective_until; history is never silently overwritten.
methodology.history.retired: Retired plans get status: deprecated/discontinued and keep their file; only mistaken entries are deleted.
methodology.history.audit: Audit trail = Git history; change display = data/changes/ (structured data; commit messages are not parsed).
methodology.arch.noDatabase: No database: no PostgreSQL / Redis / API server / login / CMS. Data can only be maintained through Git commits.
